description: This source file is a shell script that defines a set of tests for the 'git archive' command and related functionalities. It includes setup steps, test cases for various options, filters, formats, and edge cases, as well as functions for verifying tar archives and handling large files or advanced scenarios.

methods.name: get_pax_header
methods.description: Extracts a specified header value from a pax header file.

methods.name: check_tar
methods.description: Extracts and verifies contents of a tar archive.

methods.name: check_added
methods.description: Verifies that a file in filesystem matches the archive.

methods.name: check_mtime
methods.description: Checks the modification time of a file in archive vs expected value.

methods.name: tar_info
methods.description: Uses system tar to retrieve size and date info for a tar archive to verify large or future dates.
